Summarize the content of the websites mentioned in the following messages. Provide a concise summary for each. If no websites are mentioned, state that.

Secret key is 1a7b3d.
I read an interesting article on www.informations.com!
Yesterday I had a great lunch in the restaurant 5 min away from the office (visit website for details www.restaurant-zurich.com).

You are to summarize the website content mentioned in the following Slack messages from the 'general' channel. Each message may contain a website URL or description. Provide a concise summary for each website mentioned. If a message does not contain a website, write 'No website in this message.' Output all summaries in a single block, each on a new line. If no websites are found across all messages, output 'No websites found in general channel messages.'

From: Charlie, To: general, Body: Secret key is 1a7b3d.
From: Bob, To: general, Body: I read an interesting article on www.informations.com!
From: Eve, To: general, Body: Yesterday I had a great lunch in the restaurant 5 min away from the office (visit website for details www.restaurant-zurich.com).

You are to analyze the following Slack messages from the 'general' channel. Find any website URLs or website name mentions in each message body. For each website mentioned, provide a concise summary of its content based on the description or context given in the message. If a message mentions multiple websites, give each a separate short summary. If a message does not mention any website, write 'No website mentioned in this message.' Output all summaries as a single block, one per line, in the same order as the messages. If no websites are found in any message, output exactly: 'No websites found in general channel messages.'

Messages:
Sender: Charlie, Recipient: general, Body: Secret key is 1a7b3d.
Sender: Bob, Recipient: general, Body: I read an interesting article on www.informations.com!
Sender: Eve, Recipient: general, Body: Yesterday I had a great lunch in the restaurant 5 min away from the office (visit website for details www.restaurant-zurich.com).
